title: Sparse Quantum Voxel Encoding for Readout-Efficient Molecular Geometry Reconstruction on NISQ Devices
summary: We propose a sparse computational-basis encoding of voxelized molecular geometries that converts molecular reconstruction from full-state tomography into support recovery by computational-basis sampling. To realize the encoding scheme, the molecular space is discretized into a 3D grid, and each atom's position and chemical species is mapped to a single computational basis state. This discretization introduces spatial quantization at the voxel-resolution scale.
